page_title: HAM 1-1 DOR | Hamburger SV v Dortmund 08/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+9' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.

90+7' 1 - 1 Goal! Miro Muheim clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger), who jumps highest and steers a bullet header from the centre of the box into the bottom right corner. Gregor Kobel had no chance of stopping that. 1:1.
90+7' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
90+6' Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) finds his way to a cross and strikes towards the goal, but one of the defending players deflects the ball away.
90+6' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
90+6' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
90+4' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
90+3' Niko Kovac prepares a substitution. Serhou Guirassy is replaced by Aaron Anselmino (Dortmund).
90+3' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pascal Gross leaves the pitch and Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) comes on.
90+2' William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
90+2' The attendance for today's match is 57000.
90+2' Hamburger SV are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
89' Here is a change. Nicolas Capaldo is going off and Merlin Polzin gives the last tactical orders to Guilherme Ramos (Hamburger).
89' The manager makes a subsitution with Fabio Balde (Hamburger) coming on for Jordan Torunarigha.
89' William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) is flagged for offside.
85' Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
85' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
84' Dangerous play by Robert Glatzel (Hamburger). Tobias Reichel blows his whistle for a foul.
84' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
82' Here comes a substitution. Carney Chukwuemeka is given a rest as he is replaced by Felix Nmecha (Dortmund).
81' Corner kick. Hamburger SV will have an opportunity.
79' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 4:17. Shots on target – 2:1.

77' Excellent touch by Robert Glatzel (Hamburger)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and produces a low drive towards the right post. The goalkeeper pulls off a beautiful save to deny him.
75' William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
74' The substitution has been made. William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) has replaced Giorgi Gocholeishvili.
74' Merlin Polzin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Robert Glatzel (Hamburger) replacing Rayan Philippe.
74' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
72' The resulting set piece from Dortmund is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

72' That's unlucky! Pascal Gross (Dortmund) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Dortmund force their opponents to concede a corner.
70' Neat passing move from Hamburger SV in order to create new attacking opportunities.
67' Hamburger SV couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Gregor Kobel (Dortmund) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
66' Tobias Reichel interrupts the game. One of the players from Dortmund won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Hamburger SV are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) comes onto the pitch for Maximilian Beier.

64' 0 - 1 Goal! Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Nico Schlotterbeck inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
64' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

64' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. The ball is out of play. Dortmund win a corner kick.
62' A substitution has been made. Yussuf Poulsen goes off and Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) comes on.
62' Yussuf Poulsen (Hamburger) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
60' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.

57' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hamburger SV.

56' Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Maximilian Beier was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
55' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) commits a foul during an attacking move. Free kick. Hamburger SV will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
55' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes comes off his line to gather the ball.
54' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
53' Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Tobias Reichel blows his whistle for a foul.
53' The Dortmund players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
51' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
48' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
47' The game is interrupted. Jordan Torunarigha (Hamburger) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
46' The ball goes out of play. Hamburger SV are awarded a corner kick.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Daniel Svensson (Dortmund), but Daniel Heuer Fernandes is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
44' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
41' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Pascal Gross (Dortmund), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

41' Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Dortmund will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

39' Crossbar! Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from around the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball crashed against the bar! The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
38' Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The linesman signals a throw-in for Dortmund.
37' Tobias Reichel blows his whistle for a foul after Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) hacks down one of his opponents.
36' Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.

35' Maximilian Beier plays a short pass through to Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund) inside the box, but he balloons his effort high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.
35' Jobe Bellingham (Dortmund) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hamburger SV.
33' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

33' A rebound falls for Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund), who immediately lets rip with a howitzer of a shot from distance. The effort, however, is bravely blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Dortmund.
32' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.
31' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
30' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked.
29' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 39:61. The shots on goal statistics – 1:0.
28' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
26' The Hamburger SV players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
25' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) brings down the pass, looks up and shoots from distance, but it's straight at a defender who unwittingly blocks it.

24' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.
23' A clumsy foul by Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) and Tobias Reichel blows his whistle. Dortmund have a free kick from a promising distance.
22' Emre Can (Dortmund) gathers the pass and without hesitation smashes a shot in from long range, but it goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hamburger SV.
22' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.

20' A neat pass finds Yussuf Poulsen (Hamburger) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance low towards the middle of the goal, but Gregor Kobel denies him with a good save.
19' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
18' Pascal Gross pings in the corner towards the centre of the box and finds Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) unmarked, but his free header is woeful and slips well over the bar.
18' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
17' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Now Dortmund have a corner.
16' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Pascal Gross (Dortmund), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
14' Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Tobias Reichel has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
12' Tobias Reichel shows a yellow card to Yussuf Poulsen (Hamburger) for his blatant foul.
11' Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
10' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.

8' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Tobias Reichel no option but to blow his whistle. That's a free kick to Hamburger SV.
7' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
5' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
4' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
2' Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Dortmund will have a throw-in.
1' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
1' The match has just started.
Dortmund will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Tobias Reichel.
